title: Who is defense witness Chadrin Parian?

blocks.text: The defense team presented Thursday a co-parent of Vice President Sara Duterte and her husband, Atty. Manases Caprio, in their children's basketball team, to testify on matters surrounding the credit card purchase of over P256,000 worth of shoes in Malaysia.

In the offer of testimony, defense counsel Justin Gular said that Chadrin Parian from Las Piñas City is expected to prove that he and Carpio are parents of children that are part of a youth basketball team named Elite Philippines.
He is also expected to prove the circumstances surrounding the purchases worth P256,882 in Nike Pavilion Kuala Lumpur using Carpio’s credit card.
Parian is likewise expected to disprove the material allegations under Article II of the Articles of Impeachment, to identify documents, and other related matters.

The defense is currently presenting evidence and witnesses for Article II of the impeachment case against Duterte alleging her unexplained wealth due to her supposed failure to truthfully disclose assets in her Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALN), and failure to divest in businesses as constitutionally required for the President and Vice President. —VAL, GMA News
